visibility_predicate.effect: Koleksi and Aktivitas inserted only when predicate true; matching page array uses same predicate.
observed_checks: obtains an object through state+0x27 then nested+0x13 and helper0x62d618
object+0x27 is nonnull and differs from tagged -1
object+0x43 equals true or stringifies to true/1
visibility_predicate.returns_true_when: profile != null && roleUser == 'PERORANGAN' && statusVerifikasi != null && statusVerifikasi != -1 && !(isIkd == true || String(isIkd) == 'true' || String(isIkd) == '1')
visibility_predicate.implementation_note: String comparison tokens true and 1 above denote literal strings. Local UI visibility does not grant server access. Profile values must come from account_summary; do not infer them from logged-in status.
visibility_predicate.server_authorization: not established by local display condition
